title: Tabbi pet art (pets.v1)
description: One pet file from Sources/TabbiKitCore/Pets/PetArt: art (grids, sequences, costume items), breeds (base palette, body shapes, breeds) or animations (timelines). Grids are text rows in the sprite legend of docs/study/pets.md: '.' or ' ' is transparent, 'x' erases lower layers, uppercase letters (and the lowercase 'i' and 'o') are palette roles and the other lowercase letters are breed pattern zones.

itemFrameDuration.description: Costume file: seconds each frame of an animated costume item's loop stays on screen, the pet's own frame rate.

sequences.description: Named runs of grids played in order, such as a swaying tail.

bodyItems.description: Outfits and neck items: one grid per body family, the same size as and stamped at the same origin as that family's body.

walk.description: Over the cat and dog walking torso.

rise.description: Rows every grid reaches above its body's top row. Defaults to 0.

frames.description: The rest of an animated item's loop after its still grids, one tick of itemFrameDuration each. Every frame has a grid per body family, the size of the still grid for that family. The still is the loop's first frame and what Reduce Motion shows.

faceItems.description: Glasses and the like: a cat and a dog grid, and the grid row that lands on the head's eye row.

frames.description: The rest of an animated item's loop after the still cat and dog grids, one tick of itemFrameDuration each, each grid the size of its still. The still grids are the loop's first frame and what Reduce Motion shows.

headItems.description: Hats and the like, 20 wide like every head, and the grid row that lands on the head's skull top.

frames.description: The rest of an animated item's loop after grid, one tick of itemFrameDuration each and each the size of grid. grid is the loop's first frame and what Reduce Motion shows.

backItems.description: Items worn behind the pet, such as wings: per body family, a loop of grids and their offset from that family's body origin (the walking torso's for walk and walkLong). They are outlined on a layer of their own under the outlined pet, so they may reach past the body.

walk.description: Behind the cat and dog walking torso.

auraItems.description: Items that float in the air around the pet, such as falling petals: a loop of grids around a pet facing the viewer (front, used while sitting) and one seen from the side (side, used walking, stretching and curled up), offset from the frame's top-left corner. Each group of touching pixels is a particle, drawn in front of the pet without an outline; a particle that would cover or touch the pet or an effect is left out of that frame. Not drawn while the pet hangs from the notch.

longDog.description: Around the dachshund, which sits side-on; the front loop when left out.

basePalette.description: The color of every palette role before a breed or the user changes it: eyes, effects, the default costume.

bodyShapes.description: The shared art families breeds are drawn on, and the species of each.

breeds.description: Every selectable breed, in picker order.

id.description: Stable id stored in pet saves.

note.description: Why the breed looks the way it does. Not shown.

hasTail.description: Whether the breed shows a tail when sitting.

palette.description: The colors this breed sets; other roles keep the base palette.

pattern.description: Which palette role each pattern zone becomes. Zones not listed are belly for muzzle and chest, furBase otherwise.

animations.description: How every animation plays, keyed by its id. A frame composes the pet in its pose and stance, moves it down by shiftY, paints its effects behind the pet, then its steam over the chest, then its dust.

grid.description: Rows of equal width, top to bottom.

backPlacement.description: A back item for one body family (or an aura item for one view): x and y offset the grids' top-left corner from the family's body origin (the frame's corner for an aura item), and frames is the item's loop, one tick of itemFrameDuration each, all the size of the first. The first frame is the still that Reduce Motion shows. Every family has the same number of frames.

role.description: A palette role: what a pixel means.

zone.description: A breed pattern zone inside shared body art.

color.description: sRGB as #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA when not opaque.

loops.description: Whether the clip repeats forever or holds its last frame.

still.description: The frame a still pet shows (Reduce Motion). Defaults to the first frame of a loop and the last of a one-shot clip.

shiftY.description: Rows the whole frame moves down (negative: up). Defaults to 0.

effects.description: Grids of the effect file painted behind the pet in order: they only fill transparent pixels.

steam.description: Index into the prop file's steam sequence, stamped over the chest just above the mug when the pose holds one.

dust.description: Dust puffs on the floor just outside the paws: the first and last filled pixel of the bottom row the paws stand on.

bubble.description: Point a speech bubble at the top-right corner of this frame's head.

pose.description: Offsets from the plain sitting frame. Every key defaults to the plain pose.

tap.description: -1 lifts the left paw off the keys, 1 the right, 0 rests both.

raise.description: 0 at the chest, 1 on the way up, 2 at the mouth.

roll.description: Pixels rolled away to the left.

bounce.description: Pixels a ball lifts off the floor; yarn stays down.

bat.description: The left front paw on top of the toy.

swing.description: 0 leans the paw out, 1 brings it back in.

reach.description: 0 at the chest, 1 at the mouth, 2 over the cheek.

tailSwing.description: Pixels the tail tip leans out to the side.

headDrop.description: Pixels the head sinks into the shoulders; negative tips it back.

lift.description: Pixels the whole pet rises off the floor.

stance.description: How the body is drawn. Defaults to sitting.

step.description: Index into the four-step walk cycle.

depth.description: Pixels the chest sinks into the bow.

grid.description: A grid name in the effect file.

coordinate.description: A frame pixel, or pixels from the top-right corner of the head in the clip's first frame.
